declare
 x varchar2(1);
begin

 if :ctrl_block_1.user_name is not null then
 select 'X' into x
 from system_users 
 where user_id = :ctrl_block_1.user_name
 and user_id in ( 
 select user_id 
 from fcn_grp_priv 
 where grp_id = decode(:ctrl_block_1.grp_id,'ADM00',
 grp_id,:ctrl_block_1.grp_id));
 end if;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1253');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 null;
end;

declare
 t_where_clause varchar2(500);
begin
 if :global.super = 'Y' then
 t_where_clause := 'where submit_date is not null ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'and user_name in ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || '( select user_id ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'from fcn_grp_priv ';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || 'where appl_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.appl_id || '''';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and grp_id = ''' || :ctrl_block_1.grp_id || ''')';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and user_name = nvl(''' || :ctrl_block_1.user_name || ''', user_name)';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and report_name = nvl(''' || :ctrl_block_1.report_name || ''', report_name)';
 elsif :global.super = 'N' then
 t_where_clause := 'where user_name like ''' || :ctrl_block_1.rpt_user_id || '%''';
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and submit_date is not null'; 
 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and report_name = nvl(''' || :ctrl_block_1.report_name || ''', report_name)';
 end if;
 set_block_property('RPT_PARM', DEFAULT_WHERE, t_where_clause);
 go_block('rpt_parm');
 execute_query;
end;

declare
 x varchar2(1);
begin

 if :ctrl_block_1.report_name is not null then

 from rpt_report_names a 
 where a.report_name = :ctrl_block_1.report_name
 and exists ( 
 select b.report_name 
 from rpt_parm b 
 where b.submit_date is not null 
 and b.user_name = nvl( :ctrl_block_1.user_name, b.user_name) 
 and b.report_name = a.report_name);
 end if;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1257');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 null;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY

Declare
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 v_local_time1 date;
Begin
 
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for submit_date and end_date*/
 --if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:rpt_parm.submit_date,v_local_time);
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date :=v_local_time;
 
 else
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date :=:rpt_parm.submit_date;
 
 end if;
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:rpt_parm.end_date,v_local_time1);
 
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date:=v_local_time1;
 
 else
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date:=:rpt_parm.end_date;
 end if;
End;
begin
begin

 select forms_type, '0'
 into :rpt_parm.display_forms_type , 
 :rpt_parm.echo_count
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then 
 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 if :report_status = 'C'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Completed';
 -- :time_taken := (:end_date - :submit_date)*24*60*60; Original Commented
 :time_taken := (:rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date - :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date)*24*60*60;
 elsif :report_status = 'S'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Submitted';
 elsif :report_status = 'E'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Executing';
 elsif :report_status = 'Q'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Queued';
 else 
 :dis_report_status := 'Unknown';
 end if;
 begin
 select title, subtitle
 into :rpt_parm.title, :rpt_parm.subtitle
 from rpt_report_names
 where report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name
 and appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :rpt_parm.title := '';
 :rpt_parm.subtitle := '';
 when others then
 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

procedure host_command ( command in VARCHAR2 ) is
 record_no number(4);
begin
 if :ACTION = 'D'
 then
 HOST(COMMAND,NO_SCREEN);
 else
 HOST(COMMAND);
 if form_failure
 then
 show_error('9508');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
 if :action = 'D'
 then
 record_no := :system.cursor_record;
 :submit_date := NULL ;
 :report_status := NULL;
 commit;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;
